name: @glidejs/glide
description: Glide.js is a dependency-free JavaScript ES6 slider and carousel. It’s lightweight, flexible and fast. Designed to slide. No less, no more
author: Jędrzej Chałubek (https://github.com/jedrzejchalubek/)

scripts.css:core: lightningcss --browserslist src/assets/css/glide.core.css -o dist/css/glide.core.css && lightningcss --browserslist --minify src/assets/css/glide.core.css -o dist/css/glide.core.min.css
scripts.css:theme: lightningcss --browserslist src/assets/css/glide.theme.css -o dist/css/glide.theme.css && lightningcss --browserslist --minify src/assets/css/glide.theme.css -o dist/css/glide.theme.min.css
scripts.build:css: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/css', { recursive: true })" && npm run css:core && npm run css:theme
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
